rationale: Restore per-form libc-partial archive selection when scanning syscall wrappers for PPC32/PPC64 debug and profile Libsystem outputs. Apple's PPC-compatible Libsystem-111.1.4 passed the form suffix; Libsystem-125.2.11 drops it while retaining form-specific archive inputs. See docs/provenance/Libsystem-125.2.11-ppc-form-archive.md.
